notes: Final daily plan of the week. Cash market closed Thursday (Thanksgiving); Friday is a short session (1 PM ET close). Expect thinner liquidity and sloppy trade. He gives a premarket update Wednesday, then he is off the desk.
bias: 'Bearish build, not yet bearish resolution: keeping it simple ahead of the holiday.' Monday's back-test (NQ under the July low, ES at 7305-7317) failed and gave some — not much — downside follow-through on Tuesday. NQ gapped value firmly lower and spent nearly the whole session below Monday's low; ES traded little below Monday's low but also gapped value lower. The developing weekly profiles now show bearish build: on NQ Monday's volume sits just inside the lower edge of last week's main distribution and Tuesday's sits distinctly lower, with a clean LVN between the two; on ES all of this week's build is below last week's main distribution, but the LVN between the two days is less convincing. Build is not resolution. If buyers reject the lower distribution and reclaim the upper one, the weekly profile turns reasonably bullish; if they cannot, or price is rejected from it, the bearish build gains credit; a sustained break of Tuesday's low with a third, lower distribution would confirm more. 'The evolution and eventual resolution of the developing weekly profile should be your guiding light.'
wildcard: Treat Tuesday's range as a box on both; his preferred setups are the box-edge failures (LAAF / LBAF). Breakout and breakdown trades are implied but rate only C/C+ for his style. Any downside break MUST sustain — a return into Tuesday's range without a swift move back down risks the LBAF reversion. Both remain above Monday's news candle (ES low 7084; NQ open/low in the 25860s). Tuesday's low was about a 0.382 retracement of Friday's low → Monday's high on ES and about 0.5 on NQ. Risk to bulls accelerates below 7072-7078 then 7017-7024 (ES) and below 25730-25769 then 25438-25493 (NQ) — 'now more meaningfully given another day of bearish build'. He stays open to an awkward multi-day balance above Friday's low. Daily levels unchanged: ES 7454-7458, 7089-7097, 6809-6813; NQ 26948-26969, 25199; honorable mention NQ 26300.
